integrity: Exact finite rational verification supplements an analytic proof for all finite weighted graphs. All dates are source-verified preprint public dates; no claim of independent mathematical validation or priority certification.
limitations: Only finite connected, undirected, bipartite networks with symmetric positive edge weights; the completed linear cubic RK endpoint, not stage positivity, nonlinear SSP or error optimality. Historical coverage beyond inspected publications, including the full text of Horvath (2005), remains open to independent bibliographic assessment.
title: A sharp universal positivity gain for cubic Runge–Kutta on weighted bipartite networks
